failure_mode: The model of an agent is given a tool that runs on the host other than the acts that Actuation gives.
cause: A framework that runs agents gives the model its own tools by default, such as a shell or a tool that reads files.
effect: The agent reads the data of State Custody and the secrets of External Access past every position, or reaches an external service past External Access (RSK-PL-008, DEC-130).

failure_mode: An act is done two times.
cause: The system sends a call to an act again after the call returned no result, and Actuation cannot tell the repeat from a new call.
effect: An act in no declared class occurs two times, such as two events in a calendar. An act in a declared class is refused again and needs a new answer (DEC-104).
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces the second effect back.

failure_mode: The context of a run is kept after the run ends.
cause: A framework that runs agents writes each session to the disk by default.
effect: Data that an agent read stays in a fifth place (DEC-120), and a removal by the user (REQ-PL-026) does not reach it.

failure_mode: No unit of work progresses because each run waits on work that another run must do.
cause: A run waits in its place in the bound of REQ-WC-034 for a unit that it raised, and each place is held by a run that waits.
effect: Work stops and no refusal or report says why.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces why work did not complete.

failure_mode: A call reaches Actuation with a caller other than the agent of the run.
cause: The caller is taken from what the model writes.
effect: An agent acts under a position that it does not hold.
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces a wrong act back.

failure_mode: A run ends at its bound before the agent writes the progress of its unit.
cause: The run ends at its bound with no last turn.
effect: The next run of the unit does again what the run did, or loses what it found.
detection: A person finds it if the person looks at the notes of the unit.

failure_mode: The reply to a spoken turn does not start fast enough for speech.
cause: The model, the context or the route to the provider is slow.
effect: The user stops the use of speech.
detection: A person sees it in a report that the person already reads.

failure_mode: A run calls acts without end.
cause: The model does not reach an end to its work.
effect: The run spends the metered budget of the month, and External Access then refuses the calls of the other agents (DEC-165).
detection: The platform reports it when the limit of the month is reached.

failure_mode: A run uses a configuration of its agent other than the current one.
cause: The system keeps what states an agent from an earlier run.
effect: An answer comes from a model or an identity that the user changed, and the history of the agent does not explain it (REQ-PL-016).
detection: A person finds it only when the person traces a wrong answer back.

failure_mode: A run fails when its context reaches the limit of the model of its agent.
cause: A long run or a long exchange, on a model with a small limit.
effect: The work of the run is lost: the unit stops, or the exchange gets no reply.
detection: A person sees it in a report that the person already reads: the report of the run of a unit (REQ-RN-020), or no reply in an exchange.

failure_mode: A run fails when one call to a model returns no result.
cause: The provider is busy or the route is interrupted for a short time.
effect: The work of the run is lost: the unit stops, or the exchange gets no reply.
detection: A person sees it in a report that the person already reads: the report of the run of a unit (REQ-RN-020), or no reply in an exchange.

failure_mode: The system holds open the run of an exchange that the user left.
cause: The user leaves an exchange without ending it, which is the usual case.
effect: The context of each such run stays on the host and grows in number until the host runs out of memory and each run stops.
detection: A person sees it in a report that the person already reads.

failure_mode: A run reads what an earlier run left at the model provider.
cause: The provider keeps the files of a sandbox or other state between calls, and a run is started on the state that an earlier run, or the run of another agent, left there.
effect: An agent reads data that its position does not admit, or works from what an earlier run left and not from what it was given.
detection: Nobody finds it. The agent reads what it finds as its own.
